description: Unit tests for the parse tree functionality in the Chromium project's GN build system, including tests for accessor nodes, subscripted access, unused variables, target shortening, range extraction, and integer parsing.

classes.name: AccessorNode
classes.description: Represents a member access node in the parse tree, with methods to set base and member tokens, and execute the accessor.

classes.name: IdentifierNode
classes.description: Represents an identifier in the parse tree.

classes.name: BinaryOpNode
classes.description: Represents a binary operation node, such as list literals or range expressions.

classes.name: ListNode
classes.description: Represents a list of parse nodes, with methods to get contents and shorten targets.

methods.name: AccessorNode::set_base
methods.description: Sets the base token for member access.

methods.name: AccessorNode::Execute
methods.description: Executes the accessor node to retrieve a value from the scope.

methods.name: ListNode::ShortenTargets
methods.description: Simplifies target strings in the list.

methods.name: ListNode::GetSortRanges
methods.description: Extracts sorted ranges from the list contents.
